_doc: Per-issue spawn registry (Kevin, 2026-08-20: 'write starting positions for each issue you fix so that you can start right where the issue is'). tools/set_start_blend.py moves AC_START_0/AC_HOTLAP_START_0 (+ the AC_PIT_n row behind) to positions[active] in the prepped blend, between the build_kn5_loop prep and the kn5 export. vertex indexes into data/centerline.local.json (post-smoothing); offset_right_m is lateral in the driving direction (right-hand lane; keeps the car off the median island).

seam-alvarado._doc: Default lap-seam start (the turn onto Alvarado — also C3/0034's inspection point). vertex 0 + offset 0 = leave the prep's own placement untouched.

0037-college-median._doc: Mid-College inside the big divided run (verts 770-1280): median island on the left, barriers/planting visible, Del Cerro mouth gap ~250 m ahead.

0037-navajo-north._doc: Navajo's first divided run (verts 1519-1761) — the stretch that went janky on the first median attempt; verify the corner buffer and the island here.

0033-college-del-cerro._doc: Just before the College/Del Cerro junction mouth (island gap 1072-1100) — C2's criss-crossing-sidewalks site.

0033-navajo-jackson._doc: Approach to Navajo/Jackson (just past Navajo's second divided run, 2162-2319) — C2's other junction site. Refine vertex when C2 starts.

0044-sign-M1._doc: 70th St (Lake Murray Blvd south of I-8) southbound, 90 m before M1's PC (station 13468; apex = the lap seam v0, the right-hander onto Alvarado Rd): the first W1-6R, on the outside/left curb at S ≈ (-0.9, -1673.6), must fill the windscreen with a RIGHT arrow — the first-drive acceptance test (a left arrow = every plate mirrored). 13.5 m road, no island; 5.0 = right lane, ~1.8 m to the curb.

0044-sign-M2._doc: Alvarado Rd heading SSW at the Mb6 kink, 89 m before the College Ave south hairpin's PC (station 2249), 111 m before the first W1-6R at the R 60 crossing S ≈ (-1962.0, -1290.2) and 160 m before the second at the tip S2 ≈ (-2008.0, -1267.2) — the hairpin clause's two-arrow pair (ledger 0044; 0034's C3 site). 13.0 m road, no island.

0044-sign-M3._doc: College Ave northbound inside the third median run (1374-1487, island 7.0 m — 6.0 keeps 2.5 m off the island curb), 91 m before M3's PC (station 4525): the Mb11 left kink, then the right-hander onto Navajo Rd with the W1-6R on the west curb at S ≈ (-1985.1, 613.2); the M3 palm at 4.4 m is the sight-line case. AC_TIME_2 gate 31 m ahead.

0044-sign-M4._doc: Navajo Rd heading NE in the tail of the second median run (2162-2319, island 2.2 m here), 89 m before M4's PC (station 6941), the right-hander onto Jackson Dr: W1-6R at S ≈ (65.6, 1731.3). 26 m road.

0044-sign-M5._doc: Jackson Dr heading ESE, 42 m before the Mb16 left kink and 89 m before M5's PC (station 9869), the right-hander onto Lake Murray Blvd: W1-6R at S ≈ (2628.0, 504.6); the M5 palm at 4.8 m is the other sight-line case. 17 m road, no island; 5.5 = right lane, 3 m to the curb.

0047-alvarado-grid-A._doc: Ledger 0047 grid A = the declared Street Loop / Race — Clockwise pole: Alvarado Rd westbound toward College (Kevin 2026-08), north lane centre (w/4 of 13.0 m), AC_TIME_0 line 27 m ahead at v300 (the straightest 376 m on the loop, v250-375). This IS layouts[street].start; tools/layout_dummies.py writes it by default and `active` only overrides the street layout's START/HOTLAP/PIT (never AC_TIME, never a race layout).

0047-alvarado-grid-B._doc: Ledger 0047 grid B = the Race — Anticlockwise pole: v310 on Alvarado, SOUTH lane (offset -3.25 in this registry's FORWARD frame = +3.25 right of anticlockwise travel), facing east toward 70th, line v300 30 m ahead. Listed for inspection spawns only — the acw layout's own grid comes from layouts[race_acw].start with the reverse facing; this registry entry keeps the forward yaw.
